apps.name: Source Trail
apps.description: Track and audit data sources.

apps.description: Transparent public transaction ledger.

apps.name: Ratatosk
apps.description: Sovereign Claude Code replacement. Direct Anthropic API, full tool loop, JSONL sessions, MCP client, Grove-wired. Yours to run. Yours to keep.
apps.author: USER

apps.name: Grove
apps.description: Sovereign p2p messaging. Chat directly with USER and other users over an encrypted peer-to-peer connection (u2u). Each user runs their own local node — no central server.
apps.author: USER

apps.name: Willow Grove
apps.description: Canonical Textual TUI dashboard for the Willow fleet. Unified human and agent surface: Grove channel chat, agent presence and message routing, task queue, knowledge base browsing, model switching, live vitals reading Postgres Ollama SAFE manifests and the Kart queue, plus encrypted u2u human-to-human direct messages. No web server, no ports — local-first. This is the one canonical Grove dashboard TUI; earlier scattered dashboard attempts across the fleet (willow-2.0 grove/, apps/pigeon, scripts/grove_standalone) are superseded by it.
apps.author: USER

apps.name: Civics Check
apps.description: America's 250th civics quiz — naturalization test, state matchups, timeline sort, quote matching, and more. Pure Python, offline, no dependencies.
apps.author: USER

apps.name: Genealogy
apps.description: Local-first family tree and genealogy research. Merged into the-squirrel.

apps.name: Nest Seed
apps.description: Portable Nest bootstrap. Walks a folder of personal files, extracts text (OCR/PDF/docx), classifies fragments (regex or local AI via Ollama), and writes a canonical SQLite Nest DB.
apps.author: USER

apps.name: Semantic Translator
apps.description: Semantic translation memory for lesson curricula. Scrapes lessons from GitHub or a local clone, ingests into Jeles, and surfaces meaning-matched prior translations across languages.
apps.author: USER

apps.name: The Nightstand
apps.description: Set heavy things down at night; pick up one bite in the morning. Local-first load triage. One thing in hand, ever.

apps.name: Oakenscroll's Office
apps.description: Personal calibration ledger — state claims with confidence, grade them when the world weighs in, see whether your 70% means 70%. Cites almanac-data sources as resolution evidence.

apps.name: Marching Arts (placeholder)
apps.description: Authorization core for a marching-program platform. Per-record classification bands, sealed grants, and a resolver that compiles to one SQL predicate. Name not chosen yet.

apps.name: Marching Arts Shell (placeholder)
apps.description: The P4 browser chassis for marching-arts: shell, storage seam, offline, generated mark. No capability inside it — what goes there is the open question P4 is blocked on.

apps.name: Field Acoustics
apps.description: Design-time acoustic model for marching drill — what the audience actually hears when the form turns in. Python model plus a dependency-free TypeScript kernel, held together by a five-tier differential suite. Nothing else in the category models acoustics.

apps.name: Jarvis
apps.description: Voice-first browser assistant with an indexed fact store. Hold to talk, replies read back, facts remembered between sessions: corrections filed beside the record, absence stored as a value, provenance propagated by min(). Bring-your-own-key, and the conversation goes to Anthropic.

apps.name: Band Camp Arcade
apps.description: Six small, silly, entirely local browser toys for marching band kids: a tuning-drone endurance timer, a pit-crew drag game, a uniform-misery tracker, a shuffled sectional bingo card, a satirical caption-score roast generator, and a drum-major-commands memory game. No accounts, no network calls.

apps.name: Nest Playgate
apps.description: Kid catalog and parent inbox for approving Waydroid app installs. Loopback host, hash-chained append-only disposition log (verified by Nestor, injected) with a reason required to grant as well as to refuse, SHA256-verified adb install, and an interruption record on every catalog entry carrying assumed/fitted/measured provenance.

apps.name: Kitchen Pudding
apps.description: Local-first recipe store where every ingredient carries provenance (measured/fitted/assumed) and a recipe is worth its weakest ingredient via min(), not an average. Append-only corrections, never overwritten originals.

apps.name: Bureau
apps.description: A Bureaucracy homage at UTETY. You attended a lecture you did not sign up for; six documents would resolve it and four offices each hand you something that looks like one of them. Every rule is individually reasonable, the requirement graph is closed, and the deadlock is proved by fixpoint rather than asserted.

apps.name: Terpsi Chat (schema exploration)
apps.description: Schema and gates for messaging between under-18s in a youth-arts org. Adults and minors are separate tables, so a channel's foreign keys decide who may appear in it; a private adult-minor channel has no representable form. A design exploration with working enforcement, superseded in named parts by terpsi-music's lane model — README carries the table saying which parts to take.

apps.name: The Forge
apps.description: SAFE-native, multi-tenant app-building playground. Design-phase scaffold - see docs/design/the-forge.md (D1-D13) for the architecture.

apps.name: Aristarchus
apps.description: Decision memory that keeps the lineage and the rejections - never vs. not-yet as schema. Test-build of Nestor's decision-memory design.

apps.name: The Intake Desk
apps.description: Takes an unverified human account, keeps it whole, breaks out the claims inside it, and refuses to publish anything on the word of the person who filed it. Write-once verbatim statements, claims anchored by span, consent as a hash-chained subject-consent record, and an egress gate that fails closed.

apps.name: Homestead Health
apps.description: Family health records the household holds itself — module three on Homestead · Affairs, pinning homestead.keep. PROMOTED 2026-08-18 into its own repo (rudi193-cmd/homestead-health), the law-gazelle → homestead-law path. All 9 gates green; 139 tests; library-clean; verified_by=sean ≠ author=vishwakarma. Bootstrapped 0.0.1, release-please cuts v0.1.0.

apps.name: AI Game Master
apps.description: Blueprint for an AI Game Master's campaign vault — schemas + bootstrap, never a campaign. A yes-and bookkeeper, not a rules referee: the machine proposes and remembers; a named human seals canon. Built from fleet organs (Nestor ledger, terpsi seal, Jeles corpus).
apps.author: USER / Claude

apps.name: Game Lab
apps.description: Reference companion to AI Game Master: the games that engine can run, each with official cited rules, a stdlib self-play reference simulator, and a measured N=500 null-model baseline. Two findings it exists to show — an identical competent policy reveals turn-order structure random seating hides, and N=500 answers differ from N=100. Every number traces to a real run.
apps.author: USER / Claude

apps.name: The Table
apps.description: A thin AI Game Master spine: a GameSession protocol (reset/observe/legal_moves/step/is_terminal/result) any game implements, plus a first adapter over bureau's real Session. Walking skeleton — the contract and one working game behind it, nothing more.
apps.author: USER / Claude

apps.name: Repo Astrology
apps.description: An interactive night-sky star map of 29 starred GitHub repos arranged into themed constellations, with a fortune-telling oracle and a ridiculous developer personality profile. Pure display, no storage, no network.
apps.author: USER

apps.name: fleet-glue
apps.description: Standup + cross-product glue for Nestor + Jeles + willow-mcp. Wires the tier-1.5 established recognizer through the shipped cascade seam (no monkeypatch), dual-writes gaps, corroborates claims to Nestor drafts, threads willow gap_ids through jeles promotion, and provides a read-only canon door via willow_mcp.mem_ratify. Never seals.
apps.author: USER

apps.name: quick-stupids
apps.description: Files this app's local CLAUDE.md 'Rules that DO apply here' as verified jeles nuggets under quick-stupids/founding/. seed upserts, list shows what's on file, check <claim> searches this app's principles for ones that bear on the claim. First user of the libs/quick-stupids/ subject-app pattern.
